nodes.asset_description: The image shows the year "2004" rendered in a stylized, fuzzy, pink font. The numbers are centrally positioned and have a soft, textured appearance. The background is a gradient transitioning from dark gray at the edges to a lighter pink in the center, creating a subtle glow around the numbers.

nodes.text: Finger foods, like mini sandwiches, fruit skewers, and cupcakes, are perfect for easy snacking. As for activities, there are endless possibilities, like karaoke, board games, and DIY crafts.

nodes.asset_description: A woman with light reddish-brown hair pulled back in a loose style wears a light beige jacket and a green, textured earring. Her head is tilted downward, and her eyes are partially closed. She is positioned against a light-colored wall, with a dark object partially visible behind her. The image is framed by a white border and has a soft, slightly faded appearance.

Two people stand on a light-colored stone or concrete surface next to a teal swimming pool. The person on the left wears dark pants and boots; the person on the right wears a light-colored top, denim shorts, and white sneakers. A silver tinsel-like fence runs along the right side. Green foliage is visible in the background.

A woman with long dark hair and sunglasses is seated, wearing a light purple outfit with long sleeves and a tie at the front. Her right hand rests near her waist. The background is dark, with a blurred, out-of-focus area behind her. The image is framed by a white border resembling a Polaroid photo frame.
